protocol.analysis_unit: rule set with four nested initial states; descriptive development counts only
protocol.cap_policy: retain every slot and complete prefix; no continuation, replacement, reroll or relaxed limit
protocol.endpoint_policy: full-horizon AP only for complete independently verified runs; capped prefixes censored; interruptions and analysis failures unmeasured
protocol.memory_policy: sampled RSS watchdog accepted for this bounded development pilot; instantaneous bound unestablished
protocol.scope: development only; no confirmatory prevalence or biological claims
